orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: A fully managed orchestration platform that runs services in an order the user defines, in YAML or JSON steps, with switch conditions, for loops, parallel steps and subworkflows. It is application-general rather than built around data pipelines.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Executions can be scheduled with Cloud Scheduler, a separate service, as well as started from the console or the API.

presentation.tagline: Serverless orchestration of Google Cloud services and HTTP APIs.
